ContentDigest.description: RFC 9530 SHA-256 digest of the exact request body covered by Signature.
ContentDigest.name: Content-Digest

IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque retry key scoped to principal, method, and path. Reuse only for an identical request whose response may have been lost. Secret-bearing authentication, Invite issuance/claim, and artifact capability operations intentionally do not persist replay responses.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

Signature.description: RFC 9421 Ed25519 HTTP message signature named sig1.
Signature.name: Signature

SignatureInput.description: RFC 9421 signature parameters for the VGen sig1 profile.
SignatureInput.name: Signature-Input

WorkerEnrollmentContentDigest.description: Required only when the Worker claim-key signature alternative is used; omit when authenticating with a Workspace issuer session.

WorkerEnrollmentSignature.description: Required only when the Worker claim-key signature alternative is used; omit when authenticating with a Workspace issuer session.
WorkerEnrollmentSignature.name: Signature

WorkerEnrollmentSignatureInput.description: Required only when the Worker claim-key signature alternative is used; omit when authenticating with a Workspace issuer session.
WorkerEnrollmentSignatureInput.name: Signature-Input

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the client should retry the rate-limited request.

PublicReleaseArtifact.description: Public, non-secret installer metadata returned to clients.
PublicReleaseArtifact.title: PublicReleaseArtifact

TaskPreflight.description: Public scheduling facts used for a non-reserving readiness check.
TaskPreflight.title: TaskPreflight

VGenArtifactMediaMetadata.description: Closed, bounded media facts safe for Gateway scheduling and usage. Free-form descriptions and prompt-derived text are forbidden.

VGenPublicRequirements.description: Closed, non-sensitive scheduling facts. Prompt text, filenames, private workflow parameters, and arbitrary metadata are forbidden.

WorkerInviteCreate.description: Owner/admin authorization for a credential-free Worker enrollment.
WorkerInviteCreate.title: WorkerInviteCreate

VGenSession.description: A key-bound, short-lived Gateway session obtained from the challenge exchange. Protected mutations also require the VGen HTTP signature headers.

VGenWorkerEnrollmentSignature.description: Pending Workers authenticate enrollment status reads with the locally generated Worker signing key. Content-Digest and Signature-Input are required, and the signature nonce is replay protected.
VGenWorkerEnrollmentSignature.name: Signature
